interpretationUnits.title: Life Palace in the palace network
interpretationUnits.plainLanguageExplanation: This theme comes from Life Palace, its 1 admitted star placement(s), 1 recorded transformation(s), and its network relation with Movement Palace; the palace is not interpreted in isolation. When the network functions coherently, one constructive expression may be: How the chart organizes self-direction, role orientation and the way a person meets situations. It is a structural domain, not a fixed identity claim. Central coordination, integration, stewardship and role-centered organization. Increases attraction, access, resource flow or ease around the transformed star. It does not guarantee gain. When one palace demand dominates the network, support from the opposite or triad context may be harder to use; this is a conditional alternative.
